name: shots/two-way
description: 2-Way Missile v2 (w15-WEAPONLOOK2): hand-drawn native opposed dart — a bright forward head with a red aft flare, compact and centred (not full-width); frame 0 climbs, frame 1 dives (its vertical mirror). The pair's signature is the red engine and the up/down flip, setting it apart from double and the horizontal bolts (w15-WEAPONLOOK § 6).
